messages:
jordan: Midweek release pulse: short update for the train. Notable items: 1) we're holding a soft-freeze for non-critical UX changes starting tonight 00:00 UTC for 18h to prioritize infra rollouts, 2) canary health looks mostly green but one shard showed elevated p95, 3) changelog highlights posted below.

mei: Soft-freeze scope? Is docs or SDK patching allowed?

jordan: Soft-freeze = block non-user-visible UI tweaks and minor feature flags. Docs, SDK patch releases, and infra tooling are allowed if they follow the fast-track checklist. If you need an exception, use the permit flow.

rahul: Noted. Which shard had p95 blips and what's the mitigation?

jordan: Shard: model-router-12 in eu-central. Observed p95 ~80ms above baseline during a small traffic burst. Ops throttled the spike source and we bumped memory-headroom on the router pods. Monitoring for 2h.

ops-oncall: Confirmed. We added a soft throttle on the high-QPS client and restarted two router pods with increased heap. Metrics trending back to baseline. Will post dashboards in 30m.

jordan: Changelog highlights (short):
- routing: backpressure smoothing enabled by default for model-router (opt-in was removed)
- infra: kernel netstack patch deployed to the canary rack, no regressions on soak
- sdk: new retry-policy bumped to v2 (docs live)
- experiments: fast-track lane pilot enabled for infra tooling PRs

rahul: For exceptions during the soft-freeze, what's the command?

jordan: Use:
```
/permit-deploy SOFT-FREEZE-EXC --pr <URL> --owner <name> --reason "brief justification" --approver @release-mgr
```
Requires release manager + eng-sre ack. Auto-unfreeze is OFF for this window.

release-bot: Soft-freeze applied by jordan at 2027-01-18T23:59Z. Auto-unfreeze: OFF.

mei: Thanks. Teams with queued SDK releases, please self-certify against the fast-track checklist and ping me + rahul. We'll triage exceptions quickly.

jordan: Will post a short post-freeze status note in this thread after the 18h window and include links to the canary dashboards and the changelog. Thanks all.
